import pytest
from jinja2 import Environment
from jinja2.nodes import Template


class TestHashing:
    def test_template_hash(self, env):
        template = env.parse("hash test")
        # The bug causes a TypeError when hashing a Template node.
        # We assert that hashing it does not raise an exception.
        assert hash(template) is not None

    def test_template_with_list_field_hash(self, env):
        # This test case specifically targets a node with a list field,
        # which is the root cause of the TypeError.
        # Template.body is a list of nodes.
        template_node = Template(body=[])
        assert hash(template_node) is not None
